Subject: Legacy Bank - On-prem air-gapped deployment qualification (post-call follow-up)

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + a few follow-ups so we can line up the technical deep-dive:

Summary from our call:
- Legacy Bank is strongly leaning toward a fully on-prem, air-gapped deployment for POC and production due to regulatory and data residency requirements.
- Primary requirements to validate: hardware footprint and GPU count, data ingestion offline process, software upgrade/patch process in an air-gapped environment, and key management (HSM/KMS) integration.
- Maintenance/upgrade windows are constrained - you mentioned weekly windows (Saturdays) and limited physical access windows for the data centers.

Follow-ups / asks from Redwood:
1) Could you share a basic network diagram and current hardware inventory for the target cluster (make/model, GPU type, interconnect)? A simple PDF is fine.
2) Please confirm your preferred maintenance window(s) and any blackout periods for upgrades.
3) Any procurement timeline or PO cadence we should be aware of (Megan, copied)?
4) Please review the attached "RB_onprem_requirements_checklist.xlsx" - it lists the typical items we validate during qualification.

Proposed next steps:
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week between your infra team and our on-prem engineers (Dev) to go through the network diagram and upgrade/airgap processes.
- Once we have the inventory, we'll produce a recommended hardware/config and an offline upgrade playbook for review.

If you can drop the network diagram and the hardware inventory into the shared Drive link below, Dev will pick up and propose dates for the deep-dive.

Drive (preferred): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_drive

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming answers inline below and attaching our high-level network diagram and inventory export.

Answers / notes:
- Deployment posture: Confirmed - POC + production will be on-prem, air-gapped. We cannot use hosted API or cross-region dedicated at this time.
- Hardware baseline: We currently have two data centers running Dell R7525 servers. For the initial POC we anticipate 6-8 x NVIDIA A40 (48GB) GPUs distributed across two racks; final quantity TBD after your sizing.
- Interconnect: Mellanox HDR with a 200Gbps spine.
- Storage: Mixed NVMe local + an internal S3-compatible object store accessible only within the cluster (no external egress).
- Maintenance windows: Saturdays 02:00-06:00 local time. Blackout period for month-end batch processing (last 3 days of month) - minimal maintenance then.
- Key management: We use an on-prem HSM (Thales) and would expect Redwood to integrate via offline key import or an HSM proxy model.
- Procurement: Megan - our procurement timeline targets a decision by end of Q3; POs expected in Q4.

Attachments: legacybank_network_diagram.pdf, legacy_inventory_20270615.csv

We have copied the infra team on this thread. Looking forward to the technical deep-dive - suggest Wed/Thu next week afternoon for the meeting.

- Alex

Thanks Marissa / Alex - I'll take this one. A few technical clarifying questions for the agenda so we can make the deep-dive efficient:

1) Can you confirm whether the object store is accessible from the compute nodes (internal S3) or if you plan to mount an NFS share for model/artifact distribution? That affects our recommended caching strategy.
2) For the HSM: do you have an HSM admin who can join the call to discuss key import/export policies and available PKCS#11 interfaces?
3) Will the racks have a management VLAN with IPMI/iDRAC access, or is physical console access the only option during POC?
4) Do you have sample token/sec and peak concurrent session numbers for the pilot workload (even rough estimates are helpful)?

Deliverables from Redwood prep:
- I'll draft an "On-prem Airgap Upgrade Playbook" (short checklist + rollback steps) and share it on the Drive ahead of the call.
- I'll also prepare a preliminary GPU/perf sizing matrix based on the inventory and the numbers you provide.

Proposed meeting slots (PT): Wed 2027-06-23 14:00-15:00 or Thu 2027-06-24 15:00-16:00. Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite with agenda.
